source.table: SiegeEngineers/aoe2techtree - data/data.json, key path data.Unit[<id>]; cross-checked against HSZemi/aoe2dat - data/units_buildings_techs.json (same ids, same values)
source.rule: Table numbers are copied, never retuned. Everything the table cannot carry is listed in authored[] or design{} below. tools/check-stats.mjs regenerates index.html section 1 from this file and fails when the file and the game disagree.

design.cfg.CARRY_MAX: 10 - the agreed port number (the pre-port block said 15 and its own comment named 10 as the AoE2 value; the table carries no carry capacity for this row)
design.units.villager.atkTime: 0.64 - agreed port number (the table's AttackDelaySeconds is 0 on this legacy row, ReloadTime 2)
design.units.militia.atkTime: 0.5 - agreed port number (same shape as the villager row)

cfgNotes.TILE: px per tile (single zoom level for now)
cfgNotes.CARRY_MAX: villager carry capacity (AoE2 uses 10 - see design{})
cfgNotes.WORKERS_PER_TILE: max villagers per tile (spreads the start squad)
cfgNotes.GATHER_RATE: resource units per second while working
cfgNotes.CANCEL_REFUND: fraction of a building's cost refunded on construction cancel
cfgNotes.ACQUIRE: tiles: idle fighters spot enemy units this far
cfgNotes.BUILDING_ACQUIRE: tiles: ... and raze enemy buildings this close
cfgNotes.PROJ_SPEED: px/s an arrow flies (8 tiles/s - the table carries no projectile speed)
cfgNotes.ASTAR_MAX_NODES: expansion cap for one A* query (the table carries no pathfinding budget)
cfgNotes.VERSION: save payload schema stamp - loadGame accepts only this version, migrate() converts older ones
cfgNotes.AUTOSAVE_DEBOUNCE: seconds a mutator waits before the save writes (a burst inside the window keeps ONE pending save)
cfgNotes.AUTOSAVE_EVERY: seconds between autosaves of a quiet game (the table carries no save cadence)
